name: Bixby Buttonbane
bio: This goblin quartermaster audits dragon hoards down to the last copper. His clients keep paying him in cursed buttons, which bite through every purse.
portrait: A fussy green goblin quartermaster with round spectacles audits a dragon hoard using an abacus; an overflowing purse holds glowing cursed buttons, and a tiny angry button bites his cuff.

name: Dame Clatterspoon
bio: She swore to defend the kingdom with whatever was in the kitchen drawer. Her soup ladle has since been promoted twice.
portrait: A proud elderly woman knight wearing dented pot armor wields a gigantic soup ladle; a tiny medal dangles from the ladle, which she salutes.

name: Professor Fizzlewick
bio: His spells are peer reviewed by a committee of moths. They have unanimously approved his transformation into a lampshade.
portrait: A bewildered elderly wizard professor has accidentally transformed his pointed hat into a glowing lampshade, around which scholarly moths wearing spectacles gather.

name: Gronk the Delicate
bio: This ogre can bench press a drawbridge but refuses to crush a daisy. His enemies exploit his lengthy apology ritual.
portrait: A huge gentle lavender ogre wearing tiny reading glasses delicately arranges a single daisy in a thimble vase, massive hands comically careful.

name: Lady Mouldivine
bio: A mushroom duchess with impeccable table manners and questionable spores. Every dinner guest leaves with a tiny hereditary title growing on their head.
portrait: An elegant anthropomorphic mushroom duchess in a moss gown serves tea; tiny crown-shaped mushrooms sprout from her tea cups and her guest chair.

name: Sir Trips-a-Lot
bio: His swordsmanship is flawless until the floor gets involved. He has defeated three armies by falling down the correct staircase.
portrait: A cheerful young human knight tangled in his own very long bootlaces stumbles forward, accidentally balancing a perfectly upright sword and a flying teacup.

name: Nettle Nonesuch
bio: A hedge witch who literally lives in a hedge. She charges extra for curses that require pruning.
portrait: A wiry hedge witch whose bushy green cloak is a living hedge trims a miniature thundercloud with garden shears; a nesting bird steals her hat ribbon.

name: Baron Von Breadcrumb
bio: The vampire baron cannot enter a bakery without an invitation. He now carries an emergency garlic-free crouton wherever he goes.
portrait: A theatrical pale vampire baron in a burgundy cape dramatically shields his face from an innocent croissant held in silver tongs, with breadcrumbs on his cravat.

name: Pebble the Unmoved
bio: An ancient stone golem hired as a motivational speaker. Its entire repertoire is a reassuring geological silence.
portrait: A massive craggy stone golem with a very tiny bow tie stands behind a fragile wooden lectern, a snail asleep on its stone eyebrow and crushed chairs below.

name: Pip Pocketweather
bio: A halfling sells pocket-sized forecasts with no refunds for drizzle. His left trouser pocket has been experiencing winter since Tuesday.
portrait: A smiling curly-haired halfling weather merchant in a patchwork coat pulls a miniature raincloud out of one pocket while snow pours from the other pocket.

name: Captain Velcrobeard
bio: This dwarf's beard catches enemy weapons before he notices the battle. It also catches every biscuit in the mess hall.
portrait: A stocky dwarf captain with a magnificent tangled red beard containing spoons, arrows and biscuits; he searches his beard with a tiny fork, wearing nautical armor.

name: Snivel the Almost Brave
bio: Snivel has never won a fight, but always finds the exit first. His lucky helmet is three sizes too large and legally a shed.
portrait: A tiny anxious green goblin almost hidden beneath an enormous bucket helmet uses eye holes as a window, clutching a little white daisy like a sword.

name: Oracle Oopsabella
bio: She sees the future with startling precision and files it under the wrong date. Yesterday's prophecy predicts an excellent lunch next century.
portrait: A dreamy elf oracle peers into a crystal ball containing a sandwich instead of a vision, surrounded by blank parchment calendars and a confused celestial owl.

name: Marmalade the Dread
bio: A gelatinous orange menace with a surprising commitment to breakfast. Adventurers trapped inside report notes of citrus and regret.
portrait: A wobbling translucent orange jelly monster in a dungeon has a tiny butter knife and slices of toast suspended inside, wearing a sinister little jam jar lid hat.

name: Quilliam Quarrel
bio: The royal duelist insists every combat begin with a strongly worded letter. His fencing opponents dread the appendix.
portrait: A flamboyant anthropomorphic porcupine duelist in a purple doublet wields an enormous feather quill like a rapier, ink splattering as his own quills poke through formal clothes.

name: Sister Brickwork
bio: A warrior nun whose vows include silence, charity and correct mortar ratios. Her portable chapel doubles as a blunt instrument.
portrait: A formidable broad-shouldered human warrior nun in stone-gray robes carries a tiny brick chapel on a hammer handle, a small bell swinging above her stern face.

name: Wobblewort the Beige
bio: A wizard specializing in mildly inconvenient enchantments. His greatest spell makes one sock slightly damp.
portrait: A mild, unimpressive beige-robed wizard proudly casts a tiny raincloud onto one sock hanging from his staff, with a deeply unimpressed pet frog watching.

name: Countess Featherfax
bio: A harpy courier who delivers royal decrees with impeccable speed. She shreds them for nesting material on arrival.
portrait: An elegant harpy courier with golden feather wings and an aristocratic bonnet sits in a nest made from torn blank scrolls, proudly offering a single surviving envelope.

name: Bogdan Bathwater
bio: The swamp troll's wellness spa is technically a puddle. Guests who survive his mud wrap receive a complimentary leech.
portrait: A mossy swamp troll wearing a tiny white spa head towel offers a smiling leech on a luxurious saucer; bubbles rise from a muddy puddle behind him.

name: Felix Fineprint
bio: A demon contract lawyer who sold his own soul on an introductory rate. He now haunts a filing cabinet during office hours.
portrait: A small red horned demon lawyer in a neat waistcoat is trapped waist-deep inside an open filing cabinet, examining a blank parchment with an absurdly huge magnifying glass.

name: Dandelion Doomhoof
bio: This unicorn terrifies armies by offering unsolicited life coaching. Its horn is also an excellent kebab skewer.
portrait: A majestic cream-colored unicorn with a wild pastel mane and an intensely encouraging expression has a ridiculous stack of vegetables skewered on its golden horn.

name: Gertrude Geargrumble
bio: The gnome engineer built a machine to save five minutes a day. Winding it takes six.
portrait: A freckled gnome engineer in oversized brass goggles struggles to wind a ludicrous clockwork tea-stirring contraption while her tea grows cold, coils and gears everywhere.

name: Rattlebones McGee
bio: A skeleton bard with impeccable rhythm and no internal organs. His ribs are available for weddings and light percussion.
portrait: A jaunty skeleton bard in a feathered green hat plays his own rib cage like a xylophone with little mallets, a skeletal mouse conducts from his shoulder.

name: Ambassador Slugworth
bio: He resolves border disputes by arriving after everyone has forgotten them. His diplomatic pouch is waterproof and full of lettuce.
portrait: A dignified giant slug ambassador in a velvet sash and tiny monocle drags an ornate diplomatic satchel overflowing with lettuce, leaving a sparkling trail on palace tiles.

name: Thistle Quickpockets
bio: An elf ranger who steals from the rich and misplaces the proceeds. The forest squirrels now own a controlling stake in the guild.
portrait: A sly elf ranger in leaf-green leather discovers a squirrel stealing coins from his own open pouch while three other squirrels wear tiny golden crowns.

name: Madam Kettlehex
bio: A tea witch who reads futures in abandoned mugs. Her kettle screams because it has seen next week's washing up.
portrait: A plump kind-looking witch in a teacup-shaped hat holds a copper kettle with a comically horrified face, steam curling into tiny floating dirty dishes.

name: Magnus the Overqualified
bio: A retired champion with six heroic qualifications and a forklift license. He now guards a cupboard because it offers dental.
portrait: A magnificent silver-haired veteran knight in gleaming gold armor solemnly guards a very small broom cupboard, holding a mop as a ceremonial spear and wearing many medals.

name: Turnip the Unready
bio: An enchanted turnip drafted through a clerical error. It hopes to survive long enough to become a side dish.
portrait: A small round anthropomorphic turnip with leaf hair and anxious eyes wears a saucepan helmet and holds a toothpick spear beside boots much too large for it.

name: Velvet Vexwing
bio: A dragon who hoards compliments instead of gold. Calling her scales lustrous is a recognized siege tactic.
portrait: A glamorous plump violet dragon admires her lustrous scales in a tiny handheld mirror while hugging a hoard of shiny empty picture frames and heart-shaped trinkets.

name: Brother Bumbles
bio: A bee monk whose inner peace lasts until someone opens jam. His order observes a strict vow of buzzing.
portrait: An anthropomorphic fluffy bee monk in saffron robes meditates while irresistibly leaning toward an open honey pot, six little hands trying to restrain each other.

name: Ernest Underbridge
bio: A troll accountant who charges tolls in exact change. He has bankrupted three knights through receipt retention alone.
portrait: A grumpy blue troll accountant beneath a stone bridge wears tiny spectacles and meticulously balances an abacus, a knight's helmet serving as an overflowing coin jar.

name: Polly Poltergeist
bio: A ghost who haunts only untidy bedrooms. She can move furniture but cannot persuade anyone to fold a fitted sheet.
portrait: A translucent friendly lavender ghost with rolled-up spectral sleeves wrestles an impossibly tangled fitted bedsheet floating in a candlelit castle bedroom.

name: Saffron Scorchmitts
bio: A fire mage banned from every cookery competition in the duchy. Her signature dish is the smoking crater surprise.
portrait: A lively young fire mage chef with copper curls and gigantic oven mitts presents a smoking crater in a serving platter, one perfectly untouched pea at its center.

name: The Socktopus
bio: An eight-armed sea monster responsible for every missing sock. It still cannot assemble one matching pair.
portrait: A mischievous teal octopus sea monster wears eight dramatically mismatched fantasy wool socks on its tentacles, inspecting two utterly different socks with a puzzled face.

name: Agnes Lastlaugh
bio: The oldest assassin in the guild leaves a mint on every pillow. Most targets surrender rather than disappoint her.
portrait: A sweet elderly human grandmother assassin in a dark knitted hood calmly sharpens knitting needles, offering a small mint sweet with a terrifyingly gentle smile.

name: Duke Puddleboots
bio: A frog paladin sworn to cleanse the realm of evil and dry patches. His holy steed is an extremely reluctant bath duck.
portrait: A heroic green frog paladin in ornate tiny gold armor rides a comically small yellow wooden bath duck, holding a lily-pad shield with water splashing around him.
